knowledge.name: Fixed synthetic maintenance snapshot
knowledge.detail: Bundled equipment, sensor, failure-risk, technician, service, cost, parts, and backup records provide deterministic evidence.

knowledge.name: Maintenance review rules and boundaries
knowledge.detail: Uploaded guidance defines evidence use, condition review, resource checks, approval gates, and prohibited maintenance actions.

knowledge.name: Locked persona evidence
knowledge.detail: Four canonical cases preserve exact schedule, alert, work-plan, and downtime anchors for repeatable Brainstem and Copilot Studio validation.

knowledge.name: Approved production connection seams
knowledge.detail: Condition monitoring, IoT, CMMS, MES, inventory, technician-roster, and Teams connections are documented future seams, not enabled sources.

intelligence_processing.name: Equipment and technician overview
intelligence_processing.detail: Summarizes synthetic equipment status, risk scores, service history, certifications, shifts, commitments, and available capacity for review.

intelligence_processing.name: Predictive maintenance alert ranking
intelligence_processing.detail: Ranks fixed sensor readings and modeled failure probabilities, exposing the evidence and failure mode that require immediate human review.

intelligence_processing.name: Approval-gated maintenance planning
intelligence_processing.detail: Proposes ranked candidates, windows, technician candidates, parts checks, and backup checks for maintenance planner approval only.

intelligence_processing.name: Downtime and cost trade-off analysis
intelligence_processing.detail: Compares synthetic failure exposure, downtime estimates, preventive cost, avoided-cost opportunity, and historical maintenance spend.

intelligence_processing.name: Persona-led operation routing
intelligence_processing.detail: Maps maintenance manager, production supervisor, planner, and operations leader requests to one bounded read-only operation.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable Brainstem chat experience
clients_user_interface.detail: The single-file BasicAgent exposes four deterministic operations through local Brainstem chat, streaming, and API surfaces.

clients_user_interface.name: Copilot Studio Draft experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Four skills and two synthetic knowledge files support natural-language preview while the validated pilot remains Draft and unpublished.

clients_user_interface.name: Evidence-first planner review
clients_user_interface.detail: Responses distinguish synthetic facts from recommendations, name the authorization gate, and confirm that no external side effect occurred.

management_reporting.name: Maintenance Schedule Overview
management_reporting.detail: Reports equipment status, runtime, last service, risk score, technician certifications, shifts, commitments, and free capacity.

management_reporting.name: Predictive Maintenance Alerts
management_reporting.detail: Reports ranked critical, warning, and watch candidates with modeled failure probabilities, risk scores, and sensor evidence.

management_reporting.name: Proposed Work Order Plan
management_reporting.detail: Reports priority, maintenance description, estimated hours, technician candidate, shift, parts check, and backup check for planner approval.

management_reporting.name: Downtime and Cost Analysis
management_reporting.detail: Reports synthetic downtime exposure, prevention cost, modeled avoided-cost opportunity, and historical preventive-versus-corrective spend.

tools.name: MaintenanceSchedulingAgent portable RAPP tool
tools.detail: Single-file Python BasicAgent implements four deterministic, recommendation-only operations over bundled synthetic records.

tools.name: Brainstem runtime
tools.detail: Local-first RAPP server discovers the portable agent and exposes conversational chat, streaming, health, and tool-routing endpoints.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the validated Draft pilot with four skills and two knowledge files; publication remains separately approval-gated.

tools.name: Deployment-selected foundation model
tools.detail: The host model routes natural-language requests and composes responses from deterministic agent or skill evidence.

tools.name: Approved condition monitoring and IoT
tools.detail: Future least-privilege source for verified telemetry; the packaged pilot uses a fixed snapshot and has no live equipment access.

tools.name: CMMS work management
tools.detail: Future governed seam for maintenance records and approved execution; the current agent cannot create or mutate work orders.

tools.name: MES production schedules
tools.detail: Future governed seam for production-impact review; the current agent cannot alter schedules or control equipment.

tools.name: Approved resource and collaboration systems
tools.detail: Future seams for parts inventory, technician rosters, and Teams review; no reservation, assignment, approval, or message occurs.

supporting_features.name: Synthetic-only evidence boundary
supporting_features.detail: Every asset, sensor reading, probability, technician, part, date, duration, score, and cost is fictional pilot evidence.

supporting_features.name: Four independently routable operations
supporting_features.detail: Schedule overview, predictive alerts, work-order planning, and downtime analysis remain separately callable and reviewable.

supporting_features.name: Fail-closed evidence handling
supporting_features.detail: The agent uses only bundled records, does not browse or invent evidence, and requires approved systems to verify production conditions.

supporting_features.name: Maintenance planner approval gate
supporting_features.detail: Work-plan outputs are proposals for authorized maintenance planner and production-owner review, never execution instructions.

supporting_features.name: No work-order mutation or field action
supporting_features.detail: No work order is created or dispatched; no technician is assigned, part reserved, schedule changed, or equipment controlled.

supporting_features.name: Controlled production-action pattern
supporting_features.detail: Any future action requires approved connections, authenticated roles, current-state validation, explicit authorization, and audit controls.

supporting_features.name: Locked validation and publication control
supporting_features.detail: Four canonical cases passed strict and Copilot Studio previews while validated agents remained Draft, unpublished, and confirmation-gated.
